Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment specifically targets the ubiquitination sites of VPS34 using immunoprecipitation and gel excision of high-molecular-weight bands, followed by DDA LC-MS/MS and label-free quantification.

scope: For determining ubiquitination sites on VPS34, ubiquitinated Flag-VPS34 was isolated by immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag M2 beads from 293T UBE3C knockout cells transfected with Flag-VPS34, His-ubiquitin, together with or without V5-UBE3C under a denaturing condition.

After in vivo Flag-VPS34 ubiquitination assays were performed in cells transfected with or without UBE3C, Flag-VPS34 were isolated by immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag beads, separated by SDS-PAGE, and stained with SYPROTM Ruby Protein Gel Stain. The bands corresponding the increasing molecular weight of the ubiquitin-conjugated Flag-VPS34 were excised from the gel for in-gel digestion with Lys-C and Trypsin for overnight.
